title: openwashdata package standards
text: Vignettes live vignettes/articles/, never directly vignettes/. keeps pkgdown rendering correct avoids CRAN issues. _pkgdown.yml follows standard openwashdata configuration , including Plausible analytics header ETH funding sidebar. remove reorganize blocks. Analysis, validation, testing scripts live analysis/ package root. intentionally outside R/ built installed package. move delete ; exist reproducibility. license CC 4.0. change . Missing values coded NA, never empty strings, “NULL”, “N/”, sentinel numbers -99. editing DESCRIPTION, run washr::update_description(). version author changes, run washr::update_citation() DESCRIPTION, CITATION.cff, inst/CITATION stay sync. Raw data stays data-raw/, processed .rda data data/, CSV/XLSX exports inst/extdata/. data-raw/dictionary.csv documents variables.

title: openwashdata package standards
code: package-name/ ├── DESCRIPTION ├── NAMESPACE ├── R/package-name.R          # roxygen data documentation ├── data/package-name.rda ├── data-raw/ │   ├── data_processing.R │   └── dictionary.csv ├── inst/ │   ├── CITATION │   └── extdata/              # CSV and XLSX exports ├── man/ ├── vignettes/articles/       # all vignettes go here ├── analysis/                 # analysis scripts, not built ├── README.Rmd / README.md ├── NEWS.md ├── CITATION.cff ├── _pkgdown.yml └── .github/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml

title: Interactive map of collection locations
text: trips dataset records GPS locations faecal sludge trucks collected sludge Kampala, Uganda, 30th March 2015 25th June 2015. record tagged treatment plant truck associated (Bugolobi Lubigi). README shows locations static image, GitHub render JavaScript widgets Markdown. article renders map fully interactive leaflet widget can pan, zoom, click. colour circle marker indicates associated treatment plant, two larger markers show location plant.

title: Interactive map of collection locations
code: leaflet(data = trips) |>   addTiles() |>   addCircleMarkers(     ~lon, ~lat,     popup = ~as.character(plant),     color = ~ifelse(plant == "Bugolobi", "red", "blue"),     radius = 0.5   ) |>   addMarkers(     lng = ~c(32.6071673, 32.5458844),     lat = ~c(0.3190139, 0.3472747),     popup = ~c("Bugolobi FS treatment plant", "Lubigi FS treatment plant")   )

fslogisticskampala 1.0.0
text: Released 2026-07-08. First stable release, completing openwashdata package review (#5, #7, #9, #11, #13).

title: fslogisticskampala 1.0.0
text: Fixed decimal-point corruption truck volumes introduced previous data processing pipeline: 12 35 volumes inflated tenfold (example 6.5 cubic meters became 65). Volumes now match raw source values (#7, #8). Recoded three transposed “AUS” numberplate prefixes “UAS”, merging trucks 35 33 unique trucks updating 458 rows trips (#7, #8). trips$fid now stored integer (#7, #8).

title: fslogisticskampala 1.0.0
text: Expanded README introduction, fixed Example 1 legend title, labelled figure chunks (#9, #10). Added usage examples trips trucks documentation (#9, #10). Moved interactive map article vignettes/articles/ added reference index pkgdown site; site URL now used pkgdown base URL (#9, #10). Added inst/CITATION synced citation metadata across DESCRIPTION, CITATION.cff, inst/CITATION (#5, #6).

title: fslogisticskampala 1.0.0
text: Added testthat suite asserting data contract: structure, column types, completeness, unique identifiers, referential integrity, value ranges (#11, #12). R-CMD-check now runs pushes pull requests dev branch (#11, #12). Added data validation script analysis/ (#7, #8).
